description: Get available OS images for CDSS (G3/KVM). The returned image code is the softwareProductCode for ncloud_cdss_get_server_spec_list, ncloud_cdss_get_subnet_list_g3 and ncloud_cdss_create_cluster_g3. For G2 use ncloud_cdss_get_os_products.

generationCode.description: Server generation code. Only G3 (3rd generation) is valid

name: ncloud_cdss_get_cluster_server_images
